boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified, under-21-safe ways to share art, stories, wildlife, and trails without paying admission or making a purchase.

cards.title: Browse the Bellarmine Galleries
cards.subtitle: Permanent art and rotating exhibitions
cards.notes: Leave large bags in the cloakroom, then explore the permanent collection and current exhibition without booking a reservation.
cards.short_summary: An admission-free gallery visit inside Fairfield University's historic Bellarmine Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University states that museum admission is always free, reservations are not required, and the Bellarmine Hall Galleries are open to all.
cards.access_notes: Open to all. Current posted hours are Tuesday–Wednesday and Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m., Thursday 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; closed Sunday–Monday, university holidays, and during inclement weather.

cards.title: See a Large-Scale Exhibition
cards.subtitle: Free gallery inside the Quick Center
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before heading to the Quick Center, then enter the gallery without a ticket or advance reservation.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost look at the museum's larger special exhibitions in a dedicated gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Walsh Gallery as its space for larger special exhibitions and states that museum admission is always free with no reservation required.
cards.access_notes: Open to all. Current posted hours are Tuesday–Wednesday and Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m., Thursday 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; closed Sunday–Monday, university holidays, and during inclement weather.

cards.entity_name: Art in Focus: Audrey Flack, Lux Eternal, 2022
cards.title: Join an Art in Focus Talk
cards.subtitle: A free close look at Audrey Flack's work
cards.notes: Meet in the Bellarmine museum classroom on September 24 and use the hour to examine one named artwork in focused company.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled lunchtime discussion centered on Audrey Flack's Lux Eternal.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University's current calendar lists Art in Focus: Audrey Flack, Lux Eternal, 2022 for September 24, 2026, from noon to 1 p.m. and marks it free.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Thursday, September 24, 2026, noon–1 p.m. at the Bellarmine Hall Galleries Museum Classroom; verify the calendar before attending.

cards.entity_name: Children's Storytime in the Fairfield Forest
cards.title: Listen In at Saturday Storytime
cards.subtitle: A public reading inside the downtown bookstore
cards.notes: Bring a younger relative or family friend to the Fairfield Forest section; anyone under 14 needs an accompanying adult.
cards.short_summary: A recurring public story session led by a local reading teacher downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University's event page says Children's Storytime is open to the public, occurs Saturdays in the Fairfield Forest section, and has a cost of free.
cards.source_title: Children's Storytime in the Fairfield Forest - Fairfield University
cards.access_notes: Upcoming dates are posted from August 15 through October 10, 2026, Saturdays beginning at 11 a.m.; duration depends on attendance. Children under 14 require an adult.

cards.title: Explore Birdcraft Museum
cards.subtitle: Conservation history in a landmark sanctuary
cards.notes: Start inside with the exhibits and historic Fairfield images, then continue outdoors if you have time for the sanctuary loop.
cards.short_summary: Free natural-history exhibits at a pioneering Fairfield bird sanctuary.
cards.evidence_claim: The Connecticut Audubon Society lists Birdcraft Museum and Sanctuary with free admission and identifies it as a National Historic Landmark founded in 1914.
cards.source_title: Birdcraft Museum & Sanctuary | The Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Thursday, Saturday, and Sunday, 10 a.m.–3 p.m. Admission is free; confirm current hours before traveling.

cards.title: Walk the Birdcraft Loop
cards.subtitle: A short boardwalk circuit around the pond
cards.notes: Follow the designated loop and boardwalk, watch quietly for birds, and leave all banding nets and any netted birds untouched.
cards.short_summary: A compact, year-round nature walk through woodland, thickets, and pond habitat.
cards.evidence_claim: Birdcraft's official page describes a short loop trail with a pond boardwalk, lists trails as open dawn to dusk year-round, and states free admission.
cards.source_title: Birdcraft Museum & Sanctuary | The Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Trails are open dawn to dusk year-round with free admission. Walkers and birders must remain on designated trails; dogs and bicycles are prohibited.

cards.title: Sketch Nature on Saturday
cards.subtitle: A free all-skill-level drawing hour
cards.notes: Pack your own sketch pad and pencils, arrive before 10 a.m., and choose a bird, plant, or pond detail to observe closely.
cards.short_summary: An informal weekly drawing session grounded in direct nature observation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Birdcraft official page advertises Drop-In Nature Sketching every Saturday from 10 to 11 a.m., says to bring a sketch pad and pencils, and explicitly calls it free.
cards.source_title: Birdcraft Museum & Sanctuary | The Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Posted for Saturdays, 10–11 a.m., and suitable for all ages and skill levels. Bring your own sketch pad and pencils; check the page for schedule changes.

cards.title: Meet the Nature Center's Animals
cards.subtitle: Raptors and ambassador animals at no charge
cards.notes: Visit during center hours to see the Birds of Prey Compound and indoor animal exhibits, with no need to buy from the nature store.
cards.short_summary: A free wildlife-focused visit featuring educational animals and exhibit areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Audubon's official page lists free admission and says the Fairfield Nature Center has a Birds of Prey Compound and indoor ambassador-animal exhibits.
cards.source_title: The Fairfield Nature Center & Larsen Sanctuary | The Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: The center is posted open Monday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–3 p.m., with free admission. The nature store is optional and no purchase is required.

cards.entity_name: Roy and Margot Larsen Wildlife Sanctuary
cards.title: Hike the Larsen Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Seven miles of woodland and wetland trails
cards.notes: Choose a designated trail that fits your group, stay on the marked route, and leave dogs, bicycles, drones, and collecting plans at home.
cards.short_summary: A dawn-to-dusk trail outing across ponds, forest, fields, and boardwalks.
cards.evidence_claim: The official sanctuary page states that Larsen offers seven miles of trails, including an accessible mile-long trail, open dawn to dusk year-round with free admission.
cards.source_title: The Fairfield Nature Center & Larsen Sanctuary | The Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Trails are open dawn to dusk year-round and admission is free. Walkers and birders must use designated trails; dogs, bicycles, and drones are prohibited.

cards.title: Take the Lake Mohegan Trail Loop
cards.subtitle: A free 1.6- or 2.5-mile woodland hike
cards.notes: Download the trail map, wear shoes suited to rocks and packed dirt, and pick the red or yellow route according to your available time.
cards.short_summary: A free hike through restored open space, with a longer route reaching the Cascades.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Fairfield tourism page documents 1.6- and 2.5-mile Lake Mohegan trail options and states that parking for hiking is free; the seasonal fee applies to the swimming area.
cards.source_title: The Lake Mohegan Walk — Experience Fairfield CT
cards.access_notes: Hiking parking is free. From the Saturday before Memorial Day through Labor Day, a separate gate fee applies only to entry into the swimming area; remain in the open-space trail system for this no-cost activity.
